question.text: Social Enterprises in India can access which of the following funding channels?

answer.text: Only donations and grants (no venture capital permitted)
Only social venture capital funds (SVFs) as Category I AIFs
Both donations/grants and social venture capital funds, including impact investors and incubators
Only CSR-linked funding from Schedule VII-compliant donors

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.15, social enterprises in India can access grants, donations, social venture capital funds, impact investors, incubators, accelerators, and other funding and advisory support. The chapter explicitly notes SEs use a plurality of funding channels. The Trap: Option A artificially limits funding to philanthropy alone. Option B limits to SVFs only. Option D limits to CSR-linked funding only. None of these reflect the broader set listed on p.15. Note: The funding stack is intentionally broad, spanning philanthropic and impact-investment sources alongside ecosystem support such as incubators and accelerators.
